column1: 1|Interest based only on the original principal is called what?|Effective rate~Nominal rate~Compound interest~Simple interest|D|Simple interest uses I=Prt; it does not earn interest on earlier interest.
2|A long-term debt security issued by a corporation or government is called what?|T-bills~Bond~Securities~Bank notes|B|A bond represents borrowing; a share represents ownership.

3|A series of equal payments at equal time intervals is called what?|Compound interest~Annuity~Perpetuity~Depreciation|B|An annuity has uniform amounts and regular timing; a perpetuity continues forever.

4|Which pair contains accelerated depreciation methods?|Straight line and sinking fund~Straight line and double declining balance~Double declining balance and SYD~SYD and sinking fund|C|DDB and SYD generally allocate larger depreciation charges to earlier years.
5|Gross margin is gross profit divided by what?|Net sales~Owner’s equity~Inventory turnover~Quick assets|A|Gross margin = (sales−cost of goods sold)/net sales.
6|The difference between future worth and present worth is called what?|Discount~Profit~Credit~Debit|A|Discount is the reduction when a future amount is valued today.

7|Market price per share divided by earnings per share is what ratio?|Gross margin~Price–earnings ratio~Book value per common share~Inventory turnover|B|P/E compares share price with earnings per share.

8|Allocating capitalized cost, or reducing debt through scheduled payments, is called what?|Amortization~Annuity~Depreciation~Capital recovery|A|Amortization distributes a cost or pays down a debt over time.
9|Interest divided by principal for a given time unit is called what?|Investment~Nominal test~Interest~Interest rate|D|The interest rate expresses the charge relative to principal per period.

10|The true annual rate accounting for compounding is called what?|Expected return~Nominal interest~Effective interest~Economic return|C|The effective annual rate includes all within-year compounding.
11|Money or credit needed to establish and operate an enterprise is called what?|Funds~Capital~Liabilities~Assets|B|Capital finances the enterprise.
12|Another name for the acid-test ratio is what?|Current ratio~Quick ratio~Profit margin ratio~Price–earnings ratio|B|Quick ratio excludes less liquid current assets such as inventory.
13|Funds supplied by others that require interest and repayment are what?|Discount~Borrowed capital~Working capital~Cash flow|B|Borrowed capital creates a repayment obligation.
14|A primary product or raw material such as flour or wool is called what?|Utility~Necessity~Commodity~Stock|C|A commodity is a tradable basic good.

15|Which is NOT a property of an ordinary annuity?|Equal payments~Equal payment intervals~First payment at the beginning of the period~Compound interest on amounts|C|An ordinary annuity pays at period-end; beginning payments form an annuity due.

16|Actual counting of materials on hand on a specified date is what?|Physical inventory~Material update~Technological assessment~Material count|A|Physical inventory verifies actual quantities, rather than relying only on records.
17|How many days are used in an ordinary simple-interest year?|300~360~365~366|B|Ordinary interest uses 360 days; exact interest uses the actual year length.

18|An asset costs $200,000, lasts 8 years, has $25,000 salvage, and first-year depreciation $21,875. What method fits?|Straight line~Sinking fund~Declining balance~SYD|A|($200,000−$25,000)/8=$21,875 yearly under straight line.

19|Loss of an asset’s value through use and time is called what?|Depletion~Inflation~Depreciation~Deflation|C|Depreciation allocates an asset’s depreciable cost; depletion concerns extracted resources.
20|Suspension of debt or interest repayment for a stated time is called what?|Moratorium~Escrow~Numeraire~Porcupine|A|A moratorium temporarily postpones repayment.

21|What describes accelerated depreciation?|Greater depreciation than straight line~Less depreciation than straight line~Equal depreciation to straight line~Unrelated to straight line|A|Greater charges occur in early years; later charges are lower. It does not mean greater total lifetime depreciation.
22|Discount per unit principal per unit time is called what?|Rate discount~Nominal discount~Actual discount~Sales discount|A|The source’s “rate discount” means discount rate.
23|Project profit before financial contributors’ claims is called what?|Yield~Earning value~Economic return~Expected yield|C|The handout uses economic return for earnings before financing claims.

24|A duopoly is a market with which seller/buyer pattern?|Few sellers and few buyers~Few sellers and many buyers~Many sellers and few buyers~One seller and few buyers|B|Precisely, a duopoly has two sellers. B is the closest broad description, not an exact definition.

25|A fund of regular deposits accumulating to a future target is called what?|Amortization~Annuity~Depreciation~Sinking fund|D|A sinking fund builds the future amount needed for replacement or debt redemption.

26|Which is NOT a depreciation method?|Double-entry method~Modified accelerated cost recovery system~SYD method~Straight-line method|A|Double entry is an accounting recording system, not a depreciation schedule.

27|A bond secured by equipment of the issuing corporation is which type?|Debenture~Mortgage~Collateral~Lien|-|The usual term is equipment-trust bond. It is absent from the options; collateral trust can refer to securities pledged as collateral. Do not force a letter.

28|In P=F(1+i)^(−n), what is (1+i)^(−n)?|Sinking-fund factor~Single-payment present-worth factor~Single-payment compound-amount factor~Capital-recovery factor|B|A negative exponent discounts a single future payment to the present.
29|An equal series continuing infinitely is called what?|Depreciation~Annuity~Perpetuity~Inflation|C|For positive periodic interest, ordinary perpetuity present worth is A/i.

30|The source’s return-on-investment ratio divides which quantities?|Net income by owner’s equity~Share price by EPS~COGS by average inventory~Credit sales by average receivables|A|This definition is return on equity. “ROI” is used more broadly elsewhere; follow the stated numerator and denominator.
31|Loss of value through extraction of a resource is called what?|Depreciation~Scrap value~Declining balance~Depletion|D|Depletion allocates the cost of consumed natural resources.
32|Additional information issued to bidders before bidding is called what?|Delict~Escalatory~Technological assessment~Bid bulletin|D|A bid bulletin clarifies or modifies bidding information.

33|Which listed ratio best reflects market growth expectations for a stock?|Total asset turnover~Debt ratio~Profit ratio~Price–earnings ratio|D|P/E can reflect growth expectations, but a high P/E does not prove future growth.

34|Which item alone does NOT change owner’s equity?|Dividends paid~License to start operation~Invested capital~Expense of obtaining a license|B|The license permission itself is distinct from paying an expense to obtain it.

35|The flow back of profit plus depreciation is called what?|Capital recovery~Economic return~Cash flow~Earning value|C|Under the simplified handout convention, cash flow adds noncash depreciation back to profit.

36|The actual interest earned by a principal is called what in the handout?|Compounded interest~Nominal interest~Simple interest~Effective interest|D|The handout intends effective interest; specify the time period when discussing an effective rate.
37|Desire for a product backed by purchasing power is what?|Supply~Demand~Product~Good|B|Demand combines willingness and ability to buy.

38|The rate making project present worth zero is what?|Rate of return~Effective rate~Nominal rate~Yield|A|Internal rate of return sets the present worth of net cash flows to zero; yield can be a synonym in investment contexts.
39|A bond secured by a mortgage on specified assets is what?|Registered bond~Mortgage bond~Collateral bond~Debenture bond|B|Mortgage describes its security; registration describes ownership records.
40|Original cost less accumulated depreciation is what?|Scrap value~Fair value~Book value~Use value|C|Book value is an accounting value and may differ from selling price.
41|A bond issued jointly by two or more corporations is what?|Mortgage bond~Tie-up bond~Joint bond~Trust bond|C|Joint describes the participating issuers.
42|Present worth of probable future net earnings is what?|Total fair value~Total market value~Going-concern value~Earning value|D|Earning value capitalizes expected future earnings.
43|An artificial legal being with succession and authorized powers is what?|Corporation~Partnership~Property~Organization|A|This is the handout’s corporation definition.
44|Money paid for using borrowed capital is what?|Interest~Rate of interest~Simple interest~Principal|A|Interest is the amount paid; rate is its proportion to principal per period.

45|A market-driven fall in a currency’s exchange value is what?|Currency appreciation~Currency devaluation~Currency depreciation~Currency float|C|Depreciation is a market fall; devaluation describes an official downward adjustment under a pegged regime.
46|Which accounting term represents inventory cost charged when goods are sold?|Cost of goods sold~Standard cost~Cost accounting~Overhead cost|A|COGS moves the cost of sold inventory into expense.
47|Stock held to stabilize a commodity price is what?|Stockpile~Buffer stock~Hoard stock~Withheld stock|B|A buffer stock can be bought or released to smooth supply and price.

48|Net income divided by owner’s equity is which source ratio?|Gross margin~Return of investment ratio~Book value per common share~Inventory turnover|B|The source calls this ROI; more precisely it is return on equity.
49|An issuer’s right to redeem a bond before maturity is what?|Return clause~Callability~Recall clause~Call class|B|A callable bond permits early redemption according to its terms.

50|Functional depreciation is sometimes called what?|Demand depreciation~Adolescence~Life depreciation~Failure depreciation|A|Reduced demand for an asset’s service can make it economically less useful.

51|Which method evaluates public projects whose benefits and costs affect different groups?|Annual cost~Benefit–cost ratio~Rate of return~EUAC|B|Benefit–cost analysis compares discounted social benefits and costs.

52|Why does the source say sinking-fund depreciation is seldom used?|Unstable economy~Interest rate cannot be exactly determined~High initial depreciation~Low initial depreciation|B|The method depends on the fund’s assumed interest rate. This is the handout’s stated reason, not a universal industry rule.

53|Which partnership statement is intended by the handout?|Perpetual life~Dissolved when a partner ceases to be connected~Passed from generation to generation~Equal capital required|B|This is a traditional general-partnership classroom description; actual continuation depends on governing rules and agreement.
54|Ability to convert assets to cash quickly is what?|Solvency~Liquidity~Leverage~Insolvency|B|Liquidity concerns ready access to cash.

55|What is the basic accounting equation?|Assets=liabilities+owner’s equity~Liabilities=assets+equity~Equity=assets+liabilities~Equity=liabilities−assets|A|Owners’ residual interest is assets minus liabilities.

56|Ability to meet debts as they become due is called what in the source?|Solvency~Insolvency~Leverage~Liquidity|A|The source intends solvency. Short-term payment ability is also commonly discussed as liquidity, so distinguish the context.

57|Salvage value is sometimes known as what?|Scrap value~Going value~Junk value~Second-hand value|A|The handout intends scrap value, but salvage is resale value at retirement and need not mean junk or scrap.
58|Which depreciation method assumes an interest-earning replacement fund?|Straight line~Sinking fund~SYD~Declining balance|B|Regular fund deposits accumulate toward cost minus salvage.

59|Loss caused by reduced demand for an asset’s service is which type?|Functional depreciation~Design depreciation~Physical depreciation~Demand depreciation|-|Both A and D describe the phenomenon in this same handout (see term 50); no unique letter can be justified.

60|Unrecovered depreciation due to a poor life estimate is called what by the sheet?|Sunk cost~Economic life~In-place value~Annuity|A|The sheet intends sunk cost. Generally a sunk cost is a past cost that cannot be recovered, and should not drive a future incremental decision.

61|Which liability statement is intended for a bankrupt general partnership?|Partners not liable~Only partnership assets used~Partners’ personal assets can answer for debts~Partners sell stock|C|This is the sheet’s general-partnership assumption; liability depends on partnership type and governing rules.
62|Simplest business organization is what?|Sole proprietorship~Partnership~Enterprise~Corporation|A|A sole proprietorship has one owner.
63|Book of accounts whose information comes from the journal is what?|Worksheet~Trial balance~Balance sheet~Ledger|D|Journal entries are posted into ledger accounts.

64|Common depletion-charge methods are which pair?|Rational and irrational~Conservative and conventional~Unit and percentage~Discrete and depletion allowance|C|Unit-based depletion follows quantities extracted; percentage depletion uses a specified percentage basis.
65|A long-term debt security issued to borrow funds is what?|T-bills~Bond~Securities~Bank notes|B|A bond is a borrowing instrument, not ownership stock.

66|Capitalized cost is also known as what in the sheet?|Infinite cost~Life-cycle cost~Life cost~Project cost|A|Capitalized cost is the present cost of indefinite service. Life-cycle cost can also cover a finite study period.

67|Which listed changes could support a company’s 30% growth target?|Sales/total assets ratio~Total assets/equity ratio~Equity~Any combination of A, B, C|D|These can contribute through turnover, leverage, or new equity, but do not guarantee 30% growth by themselves.

68|Depreciation spread uniformly over asset life is which method?|Straight line~Sinking fund~Declining balance~SYD|A|Equal time-period allocation is straight-line depreciation. Per-unit allocation requires a units-of-production basis.
69|Funds requiring repayment and interest are what?|Discount~Borrowed capital~Working capital~Cash flow|B|The lender supplies borrowed capital.
70|Capitalized cost is also called what in the sheet?|Infinite cost~Life cost~Life-cycle cost~Project cost|A|The key feature is an infinite service horizon with a positive discount rate.
71|Depreciation spread uniformly over the estimated life is which method?|Straight line~Sinking fund~Declining balance~SYD|A|A constant yearly charge is straight line; this repeats term 68.

72|In P=F(1+i)^(−n), what is the discount factor called?|Sinking-fund factor~Single-payment present-worth factor~Single-payment compound-amount factor~Capital-recovery factor|B|It discounts one future amount; a positive exponent would accumulate it.

73|A reduction in national income/output accompanied by falling prices is called what in the sheet?|Deflation~Inflation~Devaluation~Depreciation|A|Deflation means a fall in the general price level; declining output is not required by the definition.

74|Why does the sheet say sinking-fund depreciation is seldom used?|Unstable economy~Interest rate cannot be exactly determined~High initial depreciation~Low initial depreciation|B|The assumed reinvestment rate is uncertain; this repeats term 52.

75|Which listed method cannot reach zero salvage with a finite salvage-derived percentage?|Declining balance~Sinking fund~Straight line~SYD|A|Fixed-percentage DB with k<1 never reaches exactly zero in finite time. This is not a universal restriction on DDB with a final adjustment.
76|Interest using 365 or 366 days per year is what?|Ordinary simple interest~Compound interest~Exact simple interest~Effective interest|C|Use 366 for a leap-year basis when required by the problem.

77|Regular compound-interest deposits accumulating total depreciation describe which method?|Straight line~Sinking fund~Declining balance~SYD|B|The fund builds the depreciable base over the asset life.

78|Which method normally compares same-service alternatives with unequal lives?|Capitalized cost~Present worth~Annual cost~MARR|C|Annual cost is convenient if equivalent service and appropriate repetition assumptions hold.
79|Amount of a product offered for sale is what?|Supply~Demand~Product~Good|A|Supply describes quantities offered at stated prices and conditions.

80|Which ratio measures the speed of collecting receivables?|Profit margin~Receivables turnover~ROI~Average age of receivables|B|Turnover = net credit sales/average receivables; average collection time expresses the inverse relationship in days.

81|Ownership stock with stated preferences over ordinary stock is what?|Authorized stock~Incorporator’s stock~Preferred stock~Presidential stock|C|Preferences commonly concern dividends and liquidation claims.

82|Asset value decreasing at a constant amount per time period uses what method?|SYD~Straight line~Sinking fund~Declining balance|B|Constant monetary charge means straight line; a constant percentage of changing book value means DB.

83|An obligation with no condition attached is called what?|Deal~Favor~Gratuitous~Agreement|-|The usual term is a pure obligation; none of the printed options states it. Gratuitous means without consideration, not without a condition.

84|Increasing other inputs while one input is fixed produces less-than-proportional added output: which law?|Diminishing returns~Supply~Demand~Supply and demand|A|Diminishing marginal returns concern added output from extra units of a variable input with other inputs fixed.
85|A bond with attached interest-payment coupons is what?|Registered bond~Mortgage bond~Coupon bond~Collateral-trust bond|C|Coupons specify interest amounts and payment dates.

86|Time for cumulative annual net profit to equal initial investment is what?|Payback period~ROI~Receivables turnover~Redeemed period|A|Simple payback ignores discounting; discounted payback uses present-worth cash flows.
87|Residual assets after outside liabilities are deducted represent what?|Dividend~Return~Equity~Par value|C|Equity = assets−liabilities.
88|Interest earned on principal plus previously accumulated interest is what?|Effective rate~Nominal rate~Compound interest~Simple interest|C|Compound interest earns interest on earlier interest.
89|Trading between markets to exploit price differences is what?|Cartel~Arbitrage~Black market~A priori|B|Arbitrage exploits pricing differences; practical trades can have costs and risks.
90|A colluding group of producers formed to raise profits and block entrants is what?|Monopoly~Cartel~Corporation~Competitors|B|A cartel coordinates otherwise separate producers.

91|Evaluating monetary consequences of engineering designs and projects is what?|Engineering cost analysis~Engineering economy~Economic analysis~Design cost analysis|B|Engineering economy applies economic decision tools to engineering alternatives.
92|A market with one buyer and no close substitute is what?|Monopsony~Oligopoly~Monopoly~Oligopsony|A|Monopsony means one buyer; monopoly means one seller.

93|Two broad classifications of goods/services in the handout are what?|Ready-made and made-to-order~Consumer and producer~Raw and finished~Local and imported|B|Consumer goods serve final users; producer goods support further production.
94|Another name for acid-test ratio is what?|Current ratio~Profit margin~Quick ratio~Price–earnings ratio|C|Quick ratio emphasizes liquid current assets.

95|A construction-contract provision permitting specified cost adjustments is what?|Escalatory clause~Specifications~General condition~Quasi-delicts|A|An escalation clause adjusts prices under the contract’s defined conditions.

96|Another term for perfect competition is what?|Atomistic competition~No-limit competition~Free-for-all competition~Heterogeneous market|A|Atomistic describes many individually small buyers and sellers.

97|A long-term certificate of corporate indebtedness secured by a mortgage is what?|Bond~Stock~T-bills~Promissory note|A|The sheet describes a mortgage bond; bonds do not universally need a mortgage or a ten-year minimum.

98|Which document proves legal ownership of a financial security?|Bond~Coupon~Bank note~Check|-|A security certificate or ownership record is the general answer. The printed options do not supply a unique general answer; a bond certificate evidences one specific debt holding.

99|An equal portion of ownership in a corporation’s capital is represented by what?|Stock~Same value~Fair value~Common stock|A|Stock is the broad term; common stock is one class of stock. The wording permits that narrower answer too, so A is the intended broad option.

100|What is the opposite of perfect competition among these options?|Monopsony~Oligopsony~Oligopoly~Monopoly|D|Monopoly is the seller-side contrast of a single seller; real markets span several structures.
